stem.text: A car of mass $850\,\text{kg}$ is travelling in a horizontal straight line. The diagram shows the two horizontal forces acting on the car in opposite directions.

stem.text: One force has magnitude $1200\,\text{N}$, and the other force has magnitude $1600\,\text{N}$.
